messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: P1 - rate-limiter errors spike in canary region after 'rlv2' deploy at 2026-03-15T12:34:36Z. 429 rate on /v1/generate up ~18x. Suspected: exemptions config mismatch. Paging SRE oncall: olivia

olivia: Ack, taking it. Pulling logs and tracing requests to canary hosts now.

sam: I merged a canary config change to ratecap exemptions (PR #3421) yesterday. Canary flag was enabled. Looking at the PR diff now.

sam: `git show origin/main:configs/rlv2/exemptions.yaml` => PR renamed key `token_exemptions` -> `exemptions_tokens`. Runtime expects `token_exemptions`, so exemptions ignored.

olivia: That would cause enterprise customers to be treated like regular traffic. Which canary hosts are affected?

sam: Canary hosts: rl-canary-eu-1, rl-canary-eu-2. Spike starts ~12:31 UTC. I'll flip the canary flag off and prepare rollback. If rollback is slow we'll hit the feature-flag kill-switch.

marc: Token-accounting shows some negative delta anomalies around the same window — could be downstream of the rate limiter rejecting tokens and accounting subtracting tokens twice. Investigating correlation.

taylor: Product here — we're getting support alerts from AcmeCorp (enterprise) and NovaApps. AcmeCorp reports failed bulk embeddings. Please prioritize.

lindsey: Support triage: contacting AcmeCorp CSM + joining bridge. Ticket created: SUP-4529.

olivia: Sam, run the rollback and flip `rlv2_canary` flag off. Post commands you run and results.

sam: Running now:
```
kubectl -n infra rollout undo deployment/rlv2-canary
curl -X POST https://flags.redwood.internal/api/flags/rlv2_canary -d '{"enabled":false}'
```
Rolling back rl-canary-eu-1 first. Logs: `deployment rl-canary-eu-1 rolled back to revision 73`.

incident-bot: [deploy-bot] rl-canary-eu-1: rollback succeeded (deploy id c2f9).

olivia: Observability: watching 429 rate, token accounting, and latency. Sam, can you also patch canary exemptions to restore old key as a fallback so we don't rely only on the flag?

sam: Applying emergency patch with fallback keys:
```
# configs/rlv2/exemptions.yaml
token_exemptions:
  - AcmeCorp
  - NovaApps
# preserve new key to be backward-compatible
exemptions_tokens: []
```
`kubectl apply -f configs/rlv2/exemptions.yaml -n infra` -> applied.

marc: I deployed an accounting-bridge tolerant parser to accept both `token_exemptions` and `exemptions_tokens`. Logs now show accounting deltas stabilizing.

olivia: Metrics update: 429 rate dropping from 18x -> ~1.4x within 7 minutes on canary. Latency SLOs stable. AcmeCorp still saw an intermittent 429 at 12:41 UTC.

lindsey: AcmeCorp on bridge confirms error rate dropped significantly; they saw one last 429 at 12:41 and then errors stopped. I've escalated to their SLA ops and logged a follow-up.

taylor: Product request: any token billing impact? Need list of affected requests for billing team.

marc: Accounting export in progress. Initial estimate: ~0.03% of requests in the canary window had token-accounting anomalies. Exporting request IDs + account ids to billing and support.

sam: I'll revert the PR branch to restore key names and add schema validation in the PR. Re-run CI and then re-enable canary only after synthetic tests pass. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/rlv2/pull/3421

olivia: Short term mitigation summary: canary rolled back, `rlv2_canary` flag OFF, emergency patch to preserve old key applied, accounting tolerant parser deployed. Bridge remains open.

incident-bot: Incident update: severity set P1 -> mitigated. Bridge will remain open for 60 minutes. Incident ticket created: INC-2026-315.

lindsey: Support follow-ups created: SUP-4530 (AcmeCorp postmortem), SUP-4531 (NovaApps). Notifying customers and offering SLA credits as needed.

sam: Followups: add CI schema validation for exemptions.yaml, unit test to ensure parser accepts both keys, add e2e synthetic for canary onboarding. I'll own the PR.

olivia: Any propagation beyond canary? Check dedicated/hosted logs for same signature.

sam: No matches in dedicated/hosted logs in the last 30m. Will keep scanning for 30m after mitigation.

incident-bot: RESOLVED: rate-limiter canary error spike mitigated; rollback and flag-off performed at 2026-03-15T12:38:56Z. Paging closed; bridge remains open for verification.

olivia: Thanks team. Postmortem actions: 1) schema validation + CI, 2) stricter runtime config parsing (fail fast), 3) add canary smoke test submitting enterprise token traffic, 4) run a billing export and notify finance. I'll start the postmortem doc.
